claim_boundary: This crosswalk provides mapping guidance. Formal CIM equivalence and conformance require a complete profile and conformance assessment.

mappings.relationship: Provides the governed OGARD context to which evidence is attached.
mappings.limitation: Not asserted as a direct CIM class equivalence.

mappings.indicative_cim_family: EquipmentContainer hierarchy (for example Substation, VoltageLevel, Bay)
mappings.relationship: Represents the enduring network role or position.
mappings.limitation: CIM Location is geographic placement only; utility functional-location semantics vary.

mappings.relationship: Represents the physical installed item and lifecycle identity.
mappings.limitation: CIM Equipment models the network role, not the physical unit.

mappings.indicative_cim_family: Asset–PowerSystemResource association with Asset lifecycle dates
mappings.relationship: Bridges equipment identity and functional location through time.
mappings.limitation: OGARD-specific relationship assembled from relevant CIM concepts.

mappings.relationship: Represents the observation channel and its mapping context.
mappings.limitation: Historian tags and channel lifecycles require local extensions.

mappings.indicative_cim_family: No single direct equivalent; may reference CIM messages or domain records
mappings.relationship: Preserves source evidence, provenance, and quality state.
mappings.limitation: OGARD evidence wrapper extends beyond a semantic equipment model.

mappings.relationship: Records governance decisions and unresolved disagreement.
mappings.limitation: OGARD control records defined by this reference model.
